author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: SonicWall patched two zero-days in SMA 1000 VPNs, including a CVSS 10 pre-auth SSRF flaw, after confirming active exploitation. SonicWall has released security updates for two vulnerabilities in its SMA 1000 VPN appliances that are actively exploited in attacks in the wild. SonicWall’s researchers William Perry and Adam Babis discovered the vulnerabilities. SonicWall confirmed that […]
title: SonicWall Patches Two New Actively Exploited Zero-Days in SMA 1000 VPNs
